simple.summary: זִרְמָה (zirmâh) means a gushing of fluid (semen) First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 20.

definitions.full: H2231. zirmah זִרְמָה noun feminine issue (of semen virile ), in figure of the paramours of Jerusalem זִרְמָתָם סוּסִים וְזִרְמַת Ezek 23:20 .
